audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart handed Veigar the last two stages and called 4-5 and 6 'Skill', contradicting the content layer and the packet, which both give LeBlanc all seven rows.
audit.why: 53.04% over 1514 games is the strongest LeBlanc win rate in my slice, and packet.levelChart is LeBlanc 7/7. The lane's difficulty is one thing: whether you respect Event Horizon's 725 radius, which your 925 chain simply outranges.
audit.corrected: LeBlanc on all seven rows; the late row is won by opening first from outside the cage, not by out-scaling him.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose keyed every window off 'his long Dark Matter cooldown', a number the kit does not support.
audit.why: Riot's own text says stacks of Phenomenal Evil REDUCE Dark Matter's cooldown, and the kit file records no rank cooldown for it at all — so it gets shorter as the game goes, and building advice on it being long is backwards. Event Horizon at 20/18.5/17/15.5/14 is the real cooldown to schedule around, with Primordial Burst at 120/90/60 behind it.
audit.corrected: Step up on Event Horizon's 20-second rank-1 downtime. Baleful Strike is 6s and hits the first two targets; Primordial Burst is 120s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanics were absent and one was invented: Primordial Burst scaling on missing health, Baleful Strike's permanent AP on minion kills as a thing you can deny, and 'Chaos Orb' as a LeBlanc ability.
audit.why: Riot text for R: 'increasing based on the target's missing health' — so being chipped is what makes him lethal, which no field said. Q: 'Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently' — his scaling is farmable and partly deniable. Chaos Orb is not in LeBlanc's kit; Ethereal Chains (E) in the same sentence is correct.
audit.corrected: Range war stated properly: your E is 925, his cage 725, his R 650. Open from outside it, and do not sit low against a missing-health execute.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields told the player to engage 'from stealth' or 'flank through stealth'.
audit.why: LeBlanc has no stealth tool. Her passive makes her invisible for 1 second and spawns Mirror Image only when she drops below 40% Health — it is a panic button that fires on its own, not an engage. Two other fields said to 'bait with your W clone'; W is Distortion, a dash, and produces no clone.
audit.corrected: Engage from range instead: chain at 925, outside the 725 cage. Mirror Image is described as what it is — an 8-second decoy that appears when you are already in trouble.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries the real numbers.
audit.corrected: Event Horizon 20 to 14, Baleful Strike 6 at rank 1, Primordial Burst 120 at rank 1.

notes: PACKET SUSPECTNAME FALSE POSITIVES: two of the three flagged names — 'Event Horizon's' and 'Event Horizon-' in mid — are the correct ability with punctuation attached, and I left both. The third, 'Ethereal Chains-' in spikes[1].text, is also correct (it is LeBlanc's E); what was actually wrong in that sentence was 'Chaos Orb', which the packet did NOT flag and which is not a LeBlanc ability at all. Second real defect, four fields deep: the page repeatedly told the player to engage 'from stealth' or 'flank through stealth'. LeBlanc has no stealth engage — her passive gives 1 second of invisibility and an 8-second Mirror Image only after she drops below 40% Health. Two more fields said to bait with 'your W clone'; W is Distortion, a dash, and makes no clone. Third: every window on the page was keyed to 'his long Dark Matter cooldown', but Riot's text says Phenomenal Evil stacks REDUCE that cooldown and the kit file records no rank value for it, so the cooldown shrinks as the game goes and the advice was inverted. All windows are now keyed to Event Horizon's 20s at rank 1. Two mechanics reached the page for the first time: Primordial Burst scales on the target's missing health (so playing chipped is what makes him lethal — this is the single most useful thing that was missing), and Baleful Strike grants permanent AP on the minions it kills, which is partly deniable. Cross-layer chart fixed: phases[3] and [4] read 'Skill' and phases[5] and [6] read 'Veigar', while win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read LeBlanc on all seven rows and the win rate is 53.04% — the strongest in my slice. win[N] already correct, so no content-layer chart edits were needed; all seven whys rewritten in the same proposal. phases[N].rating left alone throughout (cannot determine owner-favourability vs difficulty from the data). NOTE ON A KIT-FILE ODDITY: Dark Matter's cd field reads '0', which is a tooltip-parse artefact rather than a real zero-second cooldown. I asserted no number for it anywhere.
